source_reviews.review_mode: Retained final original PDF Section2.1/PDF3 sampling periods, Section2.3/PDF4–5 operators, Table1/PDF5 and Table2/PDF11. Pages5 and11 rendered and actually viewed; all seven rows checked against existing width audit and inventory. No raw-profile processing or figure digitization.

deferred_candidates.reason: Marini2008 shallow<5m spring feature is an offshore filament of the coastal plume, outside the principal-route current definition. Do not promote that filament thickness to a whole WAC depth.

Campanelli2013 LIW near200m is an intermediate component; catalog reference is a surface corridor. Seek direct surface-current depth evidence rather than silently inheriting the intermediate-water depth.

references.geographic_scope: Source section 1: West Antarctic Peninsula continental shelf.
references.temporal_scope: Moving-median composite of disjoint historical seal-profile sampling periods and both source seasons. No dated synoptic section or continuous2005–2015 coverage.
references.source_definition: Source Table2 mean depth of the salinity-selected AACC layer, retaining its same-section spatial depth range.
references.source_citation: Schubert, Thompson, Speer, Schulze Chretien and Bebieva(2021), The Antarctic Coastal Current in the Bellingshausen Sea, doi:10.5194/tc-15-4179-2021.
references.source_locator: Final original Table2 printed4189/PDF11 row1; Table1 printed4183/PDF5 row1; methods2.1–2.3 printed4181–4183/PDF3–5.
references.qualification: Mean depth and depth range summarize one non-simultaneous composite section selected by the34.4psu isohaline, not a detected full-flow bottom, uncertainty interval or annual envelope. The400m no-motion reference is a processing choice, not current thickness. Matching width is retained by exact same-source row/operator join; this does not establish section area because the precise mean-depth weighting has not been independently recovered. No rectangular cross-section, dated footprint, along-route profile or volume inferred. Seven sections are spatial cases, not seven independent time repeats. Source Table1 summer dominance in sections1 and6 is retained; section6 conflicts with the prose assertion of winter dominance except section1. Regional coastal current remains distinct from Antarctic Slope Current.
references.source_spatial_depth_range_interpretatio: Within-composite-section spatial range of the selected depth, not uncertainty, confidence bounds or seasonal extrema.
